title: Subarrays with XOR at Least K
description:
Given an array of positive integers nums of length n and a non‑negative integer k.

Return the number of **contiguous subarrays** whose bitwise XOR of all elements is **greater** than or **equal** to k.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Subarrays with XOR at Least K.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
